records.title: NLRP3 inflammasome activation in septic acute kidney injury
records.abstract: We studied NLRP3 inflammasome activation in renal tubular cells from 42 patients with septic acute kidney injury. Caspase-1 cleavage and IL-1beta release were measured and correlated with renal recovery.

records.title: Gasdermin D cleavage mediates pyroptosis in sepsis
records.abstract: In a mouse model of caecal ligation and puncture, gasdermin D cleavage caused pyroptotic death of tubular epithelial cells. GSDMD inhibition reduced kidney injury scores.
records.journal: Journal of the American Society of Nephrology
